Class VirtualView

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.client.view.VirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Remote, IF_GameView
Direct Known Subclasses:
RMIView, SocketView
public abstract class VirtualView extends Object implements IF_GameView
View implementation Client-Side.
This Class represents the View: it works with different communication protocols, depending on the implementation.
It works as a first line of control against illegal moves, before sending them to the Controller.

      public abstract void findServer(String path, int port) throws IOException
      Open the connection to the Server.
      This method establishes the communication between this View and the Server, first connecting to it, then notify that it wants to connect via the Server method server.handleConnection(view).
      Pre: path != null
      Parameters:
      path - URL of the Server.
      port - Port opened by the Server.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.
